simple.summary: בְּדַד (Bᵉdad) means Bedad , an Edomite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 46.

definitions.full: H911. Bedad בְּדַד proper name, masculine father of an Edom . ruler ( הֲדַד ) Gen 36:35 = 1Chr 1:46 . בְּדֵי see דַּי .
